patches.name: Add documents provider
patches.description: Adds a documents provider so the app's data folders can be accessed from the system file manager.

patches.name: Add mtbinloader2 lib
patches.description: Add libmtbinloader2.so to the app's native library path.

patches.name: Change Package Name
patches.description: Changes the app package name to install patch without uninstalling original app. By default, .morphe is appended.

options.description: Package name to use for the cloned app.
Update custom permissions declared by the app. Fixes installation conflicts.
Update provider names declared by the app. Fixes installation conflicts.

patches.name: Change app branding
patches.description: Changes the app name shown in the launcher.

options.description: The name of the app shown in the launcher.

patches.name: Remove music
patches.description: Removes music files. This reduces app size.
